summary: Biological inference remains specimen-level. Routine summaries expose one apparent width and its same-plane ratio; P90, area-length, perturbation, and legacy values remain technical QC.

evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py performs group tests on specimen-level summaries.
analysis_summary.csv/json and biological comparison metrics include median_body_width_um but exclude P90, area-length, and legacy widths.
Incomplete cohorts remain descriptive-only and cannot generate inferential comparisons.

limitations: Threshold and repeatability evidence are technical diagnostics, not genotype comparisons.
recommended_follow_up: Continue using specimen medians for between-group inference.
